name: Paterna del Río (Spain)
description: Quartered yellow and red by a double white cross set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Paterna del Río (pomegranates on blue above waves).
history: Paterna del Río adopted its arms and flag officially on 12 March 2015; the flag is described as a rectangle of 25 by 15 units with gold and red fields alternating in four quarters separated by a double silver ribbon crossing at right angles towards the hoist, with the official arms centred at the intersection.
